theme.title: Full-Court Mix
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: Counting the regular season and playoffs together, how many games did the 1995–96 Bulls win?
questions.context: Chicago Bulls · 1995–96 · regular season plus playoffs
questions.note: 87 wins and 13 losses, the best combined record in NBA history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 1995–96 Bulls have the best combined regular and postseason record in NBA history at 87–13

funFacts.text: That Bulls team introduced black alternate road uniforms with red pinstripes, a look closely associated with the dynasty.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bulls revealed new black alternate road uniforms, which featured red pinstripes

funFacts.text: Chicago reunited several former Detroit Bad Boys teammates by adding Rodman, James Edwards and John Salley.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rodman, Edwards and Salley were all teammates on the Detroit Pistons during the "Bad Boy" era

funFacts.text: The Bulls swept Orlando in the Eastern Conference finals, avenging the previous season's playoff elimination.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bulls swept the Magic to gain entry into the Finals

questions.prompt: Later 1970s champions from Golden State and Seattle give the scale. In only their third season, how many games did the 1970–71 Bucks win?
questions.note: 66–16 behind Lew Alcindor and Oscar Robertson, then a Finals sweep of Baltimore.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Milwaukee posted a 66–16 record in only its third year of existence

funFacts.text: The arrival of Oscar Robertson gave young star Lew Alcindor a legendary partner.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: A key part of this championship season was the acquisition of Oscar Robertson

funFacts.text: Milwaukee beat the Baltimore Bullets in a four-game Finals sweep to win its first title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They faced off against the Baltimore Bullets and swept them in four games

funFacts.text: Role players included Lucius Allen, Bob Boozer and Dick Cunningham behind the star pairing.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: key reserves such as Lucius Allen, Bob Boozer and Dick Cunningham

questions.prompt: San Antonio shot an NBA-record 70.7% in a 1983 game. What did the Philadelphia Warriors shoot in their record-low game in February 1948?
questions.context: Philadelphia Warriors vs St. Louis Bombers · February 7, 1948
questions.note: 16.4%, in an era with no shot clock, when teams often stalled instead of shooting.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 16.4% by the Philadelphia Warriors vs. the St. Louis Bombers on February 7, 1948

funFacts.text: San Antonio's record night came on 53 of 75 shots against Dallas.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 70.7% (53/75) by the San Antonio Spurs vs. the Dallas Mavericks on April 16, 1983

funFacts.text: Teams in that era had no shot clock, so a team protecting a lead could stall by passing instead of shooting.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Teams in the lead were running out the clock, passing the ball incessantly

funFacts.text: The franchise was still based in Philadelphia when it won the 1956 championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: win their first championship since 1956, when the team was still based in Philadelphia

questions.prompt: Kobe and Dame each hit 12 threes in a game. How many did Klay Thompson make against Chicago in October 2018?
questions.context: Warriors at Bulls · October 29, 2018 · 27 minutes played
questions.note: 14, breaking Curry's mark of 13, on his way to 52 points in just 27 minutes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On October 29, 2018, against the Chicago Bulls, he hit an NBA-record 14 threes to break Curry's former mark of 13.

funFacts.text: He needed only 27 minutes on the floor to do it.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Thompson scored 52 points in 27 minutes while making 14-for-24 of his threes and shooting 18-for-29 overall from the field.

funFacts.text: In 2015 he scored an NBA-record 37 points in a single quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In the third quarter of that game, he scored an NBA-record 37 points for a single quarter,

funFacts.text: In 2016 he scored 60 points in only 29 minutes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Thompson scored a career-high 60 points (shooting 21-of-33 and 8-of-14 on three-pointers) in 29 minutes

questions.prompt: Luka Dončić, traded for Trae Young on draft night, scored 43 in a 2020 playoff game. How many did Trae score in 2021 East finals Game 1?
questions.context: Trae Young · Hawks at Bucks · conference finals debut
questions.note: His conference finals debut, and Atlanta came back after halftime to steal Game 1 in Milwaukee.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 48 points in his conference finals debut

funFacts.text: Five offensive rebounds in the final two minutes helped the Hawks close it out.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Hawks rallied in the 2nd half to beat the Bucks in game 1 in Milwaukee, aided by 5 offensive rebounds in the final 2 minutes

funFacts.text: Later in the series, Young bruised his foot when he rolled his ankle on a referee's foot.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Trae Young suffered a bruised foot when he rolled his ankle over a referee's foot

funFacts.text: Back for Game 6 with Atlanta facing elimination, he was still struggling with the foot.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Facing elimination, the Hawks got Trae Young back to start game 6, but he still struggled with his injured foot
